fields.title: Columns to transform
fields.description: Select the columns to be converted from nominal (category) values to numbers. Only columns with nominal data are available. Use the include/exclude lists to specify which columns should be processed.

fields.title: Append suffix to column name
fields.description: If checked, append the given suffix to the names of the computed columns. Otherwise the computed columns replace the columns in the include list.

fields.title: Start value
fields.description: The category in the first row will be mapped to this value.

fields.title: Increment
fields.description: The i-th category is mapped to the value i * Increment + Start value.

fields.title: Maximum number of categories
fields.description: Processing is interrupted for inputs with more categories.

fields.title: Use default value in PMML
fields.description: This value is used when the PMML model is applied. It defines the value used when the input is not found in the mapping. If disabled, a missing cell is assigned in this case.

fields.title: Map missing cells to number
fields.description: Missing cells are mapped to this value. If disabled, missing cells will be mapped to missing cells.
